about: §4R L2: a young account — every cohort is younger than 28 days, so the sheet holds counts and no rates at all.

output.headline: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running November 3, 2026, spending $75.00 for 3 leads at $25.00 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet delivered 3 leads from 3,900 impressions and 48 clicks at a 1.2% click rate, spending $75.00 for the day.
November 2026 is 3 days old with 28 days left; Meta spend so far this month is $225.00.
The week of 2026-10-19 brought 9 leads: 8 contacted, 4 converted, 2 applied, and 1 hired — it is still young, so rates cannot be judged yet.
The week of 2026-10-26 brought 14 leads: 10 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 2 lost after conversion — also too young to judge rates.
